This instance can't start — these game files are missing or incomplete:

%1$s

This usually means a download didn't finish. Download the game again using the SAME instance name and it will continue where it stopped.
This launcher does not allow apps to add shortcuts.
Delete instance \"%1$s\" and all its files? This cannot be undone.
RimDroid currently renders only through Zink ZFA.
Pick the driver that matches your GPU — non-Snapdragon devices should choose the System driver. If not works try another one.
Drag the map with a finger to pan

If you also play RimWorld on a PC through Steam, your saves are synced to Steam Cloud — this pulls them onto the phone.\n\nSigning in is confirmed through the Steam Mobile app: you must have signed into it at least once and turned Steam Guard on there. When you tap the button, Steam sends an approval request to that app. The password goes straight to Steam and is never stored here.
Everything in your cloud is downloaded first, then copied into this instance. If a save of the same name is already here, you get to choose which one to keep.
Saves the cloud does not have yet are sent straight away. Anything that would replace a save already up there is listed first, so you can decide. Close the game before sending.
Kept the copy on this phone: %1$s
Done: %1$d copied in, %2$d left as they were.

On this phone: %1$s In the cloud: %2$s
%3$s
The copy on this phone is newer.
Syncing saves with Steam — you can switch to Steam Mobile to approve

These already exist in the cloud and will be REPLACED by the phone's copy — your PC will load this version instead:

• %1$s

Make sure the game is closed on both devices.
Enter your Steam username and password
Flips the game to the opposite landscape — still fixed, no free rotation. Turn on if your gamepad or cradle holds the phone the other way up.
Turn on if the game won\'t start (black screen / stuck on loading). A bit slower, but helps it launch on some devices.

Runs the game\'s own code natively instead of through x86 emulation. Usually faster and smoother at high game speed, especially in large colonies. RimWorld 1.6 only. Experimental: back up your saves first, and turn it off if something breaks.
Runs the game on an Android build of its engine, without emulation. RimWorld 1.6 only. Early test: back up your saves first.
Could not start the native engine: %1$s
New or changed textures are being converted for the native engine. This happens once; the game loads faster and uses less memory afterwards.
The game will run in the previous, slower mode. If you turned it off because of a problem, please send us the logs — it helps us fix it.
RimWorld crashed twice in a row while starting with Native ARM64 Mono. Turn it off and start the game the usual way? You can turn it back on in this instance\'s settings.
Full info shows a bar at the top: GPU and CPU load, memory, power draw, temperature and an FPS graph. Handy to see what slows the game down.
Caps FPS to smooth out swings and free the CPU for the game — which can raise the game speed (TPS) on weaker devices. Try 60 or 30 if the counter jumps around.

Shrinks textures to save memory and gain FPS — needed to load several DLC on weaker phones. It mainly affects vegetation and resources; pawns and animals are never touched. Low is a good balance; Ultra low is a bit faster but plants look blurry.
Makes the game\'s text bigger; windows and buttons keep their size. At 130–140 % some labels in narrow fields may not fit. RimWorld 1.7 only.
Lower = more FPS on weak GPUs and a bigger UI. Native = sharpest.

Detected GPU: %1$s.

The recommended Vulkan driver was set for this instance: %2$s.

If you get a black screen or artifacts, change it in the instance settings (the gear icon on the instance card).

To start playing, create an instance — an installed copy of RimWorld. Add your game files with the + at the top, or download the game straight from Steam or GOG with the buttons below. From Steam the instance is created by itself; from GOG, with the “Create an instance” button.

– RimWorld 1.7 build 4995
The game starts again after Ludeon's update.

– Background
On 1.7 the game now survives Home, app switching and screen off.

– Mods
Humanoid Alien Races and IsoRim Waylith work.

– Also new
Drag the map with a finger on 1.7; news links fixed.

– Known issue
Adaptive Storage Framework doesn't work on 1.7 yet.

Before updating, back up your saves: side menu → Import / export saves.
Zomdroid runs Project Zomboid on Android, the same way this launcher runs RimWorld. Same author, same approach.\n\nhttps://github.com/udarmolota/Zomdroid/releases

Hi, I have a new bug report.

Description: 


---
%1$s

Enjoying RimDroid and want to support it?

Made and maintained by: ko-fi.com/udarmolota

Every bit helps keep the work going. Thank you! ❤

Pictures for all on-screen buttons at once instead of their text labels. Pick the instance and press Apply next to a pack; buttons the pack has no picture for keep their label. One button at a time: the controls editor, Icons.
How to make a pack yourself

A .zip of PNG pictures, square, 256 pixels, white on a transparent background: the button paints them like its label. To keep the pictures\' own colours, add a pack.json with \"tint\": false. Name each file after the action it shows: %1$s. Other PNG files in the zip can be picked by hand in the editor. An optional pack.json names the pack: {\"format\": 1, \"name\": \"My icons\"}.
No icon packs yet. Import a zip of PNG pictures.
No button of this layout matches a picture of the pack
Apply the pack «%1$s» to the layout of %2$s? Buttons it has a picture for show that picture instead of their current icon or label.
Delete the pack «%1$s»? Buttons that already show its pictures keep them.
A controls .json exported from RimDroid. It replaces this instance\'s on-screen controls.
Replace the on-screen controls of %1$s with %2$s?
Saves this instance\'s on-screen controls as a .json, to keep or to share. Icons are not included: on another phone the buttons show their labels until an icon pack is applied there.
Controls layout imported into %1$s. Reopen the game to see it.
Remove the icons of «%1$s» from the layout of %2$s? Those buttons show their labels again.
Apply an icon pack to all buttons
No icon packs yet. Import a zip of PNG icons with Icons → Import an icon pack. The wiki lists the file names for each action.
There are no imported icon packs
Deleted “%1$s”. Buttons keep the icons they already have.
Reset all on-screen controls to the default layout?

On the MobileGlues renderer the game\'s textures are converted to the phone\'s format on every launch, which takes 10–20 seconds of loading. The cache keeps the converted textures on disk, so from the second launch on the game reaches the menu faster. Shared by all instances; the first launch after a game update fills it again.
Could not delete the texture cache
Game settings (renderer, driver, debug, render scale, controls) are per-instance — open them from a game card\'s gear icon.

Import a Vulkan/Turnip driver (a raw .so or an AdrenoTools .zip). Then, in a game card\'s gear → Vulkan driver, pick \"Custom driver (imported)\". The driver is shared by all instances on this device.
Works only in RimWorld 1.5 and 1.6 with the box64 + native Mono or Full emulation (box64) engine. The native engine (and RimWorld 1.7) always uses the phone\'s own driver.
Pick a .zip (mod or DLC) from your phone, choose the instance and type, then Install.

Several mods at once: put their folders into one .zip and install it as MODS. Not tested yet with big packs of heavy mods: a very large zip may run into the phone\'s memory or other limits — if it fails, split it into a few smaller zips.
Downloads the Linux build as a .zip into Download/RimDroid, then creates an instance from it — no Termux, no PC. Needs \"All files access\".
When this version was released (15 October 2026) there was no public stable RimWorld 1.7 yet, so we download the latest unstable build.
Your login is sent to Steam (the same way DepotDownloader works) and is NOT stored. Approve the sign-in in your Steam Mobile app, or enter the Steam Guard code when asked.

Sign in with your GOG e-mail and password. Signing in through a linked account does not complete inside an app — if that is how you normally log in, set a GOG password first: gog.com → Sign in → Password reset.

RimDroid never sees your password — you type it on GOG\'s own page. The access token is kept in memory only and is gone when the app closes; the sign-in cookies stay in this app\'s private storage so you are not asked every time, and signing out clears both.
Downloads go to the public Download/RimDroid folder, which needs All-files access. Grant it, then try again.
Saved to Download/RimDroid/%1$s\n\nYou can create an instance from it now — the file stays there, so you can reinstall later without downloading again.
No RimWorld in this account — showing every game that has a Linux installer.
Nothing in this account has a Linux installer.
Downloading from GOG — you can switch to other apps
The download was interrupted. Tap “%1$s” again to continue.
Advanced: Manifest ID — blank = the chosen version\'s default build
Pick the DLC your account owns. Each downloads as a portable .zip into /Download/RimDroid — import it into any instance from the menu. (Unowned DLC are skipped.)
Install a mod / DLC into an instance

Download Workshop mods by ID or link (…/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=NUMBER). No Steam login needed. Several IDs can be space-separated. A collection link downloads all of its mods, in the collection\'s order. Each mod is saved as a .zip in /Download/RimDroid.
Workshop IDs or links — mods or a collection
Opens a third-party downloader — download the .zip there, then Install it into an instance. (Third-party service; use at your own discretion.)
MobileGlues (GL over GLES — experimental, no Vulkan)
KEY=VALUE pairs (space-separated), applied on launch and overriding the defaults. For diagnostics tests — leave empty unless you know what you\'re doing.
Game sound is installed as a separate mod because of decoder issues. The toggle below turns that mod on or off. With sound on, the game takes a bit longer to load.
This may take up to 2 minutes. You can keep using the app.
Sound pack ready! Turn on \"Game sound\" in Settings to use it.
Sound pack generation failed. See Download/_fmod_spike_result.txt.
An instance with this name already exists
Swap gamepad sticks (left = cursor, right = camera)
Fix a controller with swapped buttons. Tap Start, then press the physical button you want for each action.
Everything runs through x86 emulation. Most compatible, slowest.
The engine is emulated, the game\'s own code runs natively. Faster.
The game\'s own engine built for Android, nothing emulated. Fastest. RimWorld 1.6 only; Vulkan only. Early test: back up your saves first.
The native engine always renders with Vulkan directly.
RimWorld 1.7 always renders with Vulkan directly.

This version can run RimWorld on the native engine: faster, nothing emulated. This instance stays on the engine it ran with until you switch it in Settings → Engine. Early test: back up your saves first.
Turn it on if the picture freezes on the logo or in the menu while the game keeps running. The picture is the same; Unity builds each frame differently. Takes effect at the next launch.
No mods in this instance yet.
The game is running: close it to change mods. The game saves its own mod list when it exits.
Start the game once to switch mods on and off here.
Not installed — in the list, but its folder is missing
The author has not marked RimWorld %1$s. Many such mods still work; if something breaks, start with these.
Could not change the mod list
The mod\'s folder is removed from this instance. Saves that use it may not load.
Disable all %1$d mods shown? Core and the DLC stay on. The load order of the mods is lost; enabling them again adds them at the end — use Sort afterwards.
%1$d mods enabled. Press Sort to put them in order.
Sort orders the active mods by the rules their authors give. Drag a mod by ≡ to move it; long-press for top / bottom.
The order already follows the mods\' rules.
These mods\' rules contradict each other; they keep their places as far as possible:
Drag to change the load order
A saves zip exported from RimDroid. Saves with the same names in this instance are replaced.
Import %1$s into the saves of %2$s? Saves with the same names are replaced.
Saves this instance\'s saves as a zip, to back them up or to move them to another instance or phone.
A settings zip exported from RimDroid. It replaces this instance\'s game settings: options, key bindings, the mod list and mod settings.
Import %1$s into the game settings of %2$s? Its current settings, mod list included, are replaced.
Saves this instance\'s game settings (options, key bindings, the mod list and mod settings) as a zip.
Tap ↓ on a mod to add it to the queue.
A Steam download is already running. Wait for it to finish.
%1$s\n\nThey are downloaded one after another, no Steam login needed. Each mod is saved as a .zip in Download/RimDroid; install them with “Install mod / DLC (ZIP)”, several at once.
⚠ That is %1$d mods. They download one at a time, so this can take a long while, and each one takes about twice its size on storage (a ZIP copy in Download plus the installed mod).
No connection to Steam. The Workshop works only online.
Copy the mods to another instance
There is no other instance to copy to.
Also switch on the same mods, in the same order
Replaces the other instance\'s mod list. A DLC it doesn\'t have is left out.
Close the game first: it rewrites the mod list when it exits.
Copied: %1$d. Already there, left as they were: %2$d.
The mod list and load order were copied too.
The mod list could not be copied.
This instance has no downloaded mods to copy.
Something went wrong? Send us a report. It carries the game\'s logs, so we can see what happened.

1. Choose the game above.
2. Tap Send by email.
3. In the list that opens, pick your mail app (Gmail, Outlook…).
4. Write a few words about what happened and send.
No email app on this device?
Save the report to a file, then send it from any device to this address. Attach the file and write a few words about what happened.
No email app found on this device. Save the report to a file and send it from another device.

Puts a newer RimWorld 1.7 build into this instance. Mods, saves and settings stay. The previous build and a copy of the saves are kept as a backup, so you can go back if the new build doesn\'t work for you.
%1$s, saved %2$s, with the saves of that time.
The game goes back to the backup together with its saves. %1$s and its current saves become the backup, so nothing is lost and you can switch again.

A new RimWorld 1.7 build may not work on the phone yet (1.7.4995 crashed for everyone at first). The current build and a copy of the saves are kept, and you can go back from this screen. Only the latest backup is kept.
A zip of this instance\'s saves: to keep, or to move to another instance or phone. Saves with the same names are replaced on import.
Import: one or more mod .zip files. Export: every downloaded mod of this instance in one .zip, which installs whole here or on another phone.
Options, keys, the mod list and mod settings. Import replaces the instance\'s current ones.
The instance\'s controls layout as a .json. Icons are not included: on another phone the buttons show labels until an icon pack is applied there.
The custom Vulkan driver and the button icon packs belong to the phone, not to an instance.
